title: Structure your Seedance prompt with clear sections (CHARACTERS, ENVIRONMENT…
content:
Structure your Seedance prompt with clear sections (CHARACTERS, ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, TIMELINE) to lock in consistent design and story beats.

Define character appearance + wardrobe + movement cadence (e.g., pause → burst → lock) to control performance style and rhythm.

Specify shot-by-shot camera language with timestamps (close-up, mirror medium shot, tracking shot, final reveal) to guide composition and pacing.

Call out key prop interactions and micro-actions (scissors spin, cape whip, razor flick, towel toss, talc brush powder cloud) to increase kinetic detail and readability.

Use explicit transformation checkpoints (hair cut first, beard untouched; then beard shaved; then styling; then mirror reveal) to ensure the edit follows the intended progression.

Add lighting/material cues (warm overhead lighting, chrome highlights, backlit powder cloud, steam drifting) to improve cinematic texture and depth.

Include reflection/mirror staging (mirror wall reflecting every action; final reveal in reflection) to enforce continuity and a strong ending beat.

es.content:
Estructura tu prompt de Seedance con secciones claras (CHARACTERS, ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, TIMELINE) para fijar un diseño coherente y los hitos de la historia.

Define la apariencia del personaje + vestuario + cadencia de movimiento (p. ej., pausa → estallido → bloqueo) para controlar el estilo de interpretación y el ritmo.

Especifica un lenguaje de cámara plano por plano con marcas de tiempo (close-up, mirror medium shot, tracking shot, final reveal) para guiar la composición y el pacing.

Señala las interacciones clave con props y las microacciones (scissors spin, cape whip, razor flick, towel toss, talc brush powder cloud) para aumentar el detalle cinético y la legibilidad.

Usa checkpoints de transformación explícitos (hair cut first, beard untouched; then beard shaved; then styling; then mirror reveal) para asegurar que la edición siga la progresión prevista.

Añade indicaciones de iluminación/materiales (warm overhead lighting, chrome highlights, backlit powder cloud, steam drifting) para mejorar la textura y la profundidad cinematográficas.

Incluye la puesta en escena de reflejos/espejos (mirror wall reflecting every action; final reveal in reflection) para reforzar la continuidad y un cierre potente.

fr.content:
Structurez votre prompt Seedance avec des sections claires (CHARACTERS, ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, TIMELINE) afin de verrouiller un design cohérent et des beats narratifs stables.

Définissez l’apparence du personnage + la garde-robe + le rythme des mouvements (par ex. pause → burst → lock) pour contrôler le style de performance et le tempo.

Précisez un langage de caméra plan par plan avec des timestamps (close-up, mirror medium shot, tracking shot, final reveal) pour guider la composition et le rythme.

Mettez en avant les interactions clés avec les accessoires et les micro-actions (scissors spin, cape whip, razor flick, towel toss, talc brush powder cloud) afin d’ajouter du détail cinétique et de la lisibilité.

Utilisez des jalons de transformation explicites (hair cut first, beard untouched; then beard shaved; then styling; then mirror reveal) pour garantir que le montage suit la progression voulue.

Ajoutez des indications de lumière et de matière (warm overhead lighting, chrome highlights, backlit powder cloud, steam drifting) pour renforcer la texture cinématographique et la profondeur.

Incluez une mise en scène des reflets/miroirs (mirror wall reflecting every action; final reveal in reflection) pour assurer la continuité et une fin marquante.

ja.content:
Seedanceのpromptは、明確なセクション（CHARACTERS、ENVIRONMENT、MOOD、TIMELINE）に分けて構成し、一貫したデザインとストーリーの流れを固定します。

キャラクターの外見＋衣装＋動きのリズム（例：pause → burst → lock）を定義して、演技スタイルとテンポをコントロールします。

タイムスタンプ付きでショットごとのカメラ言語を指定し（close-up、mirror medium shot、tracking shot、final reveal）、構図とペーシングを導きます。

重要な小道具のやり取りや細かな動き（scissors spin、cape whip、razor flick、towel toss、talc brush powder cloud）を明記して、動きのあるディテールと読みやすさを高めます。

明確な変身のチェックポイント（まず髪を切る、ひげはそのまま；次にひげを剃る；その後スタイリング；最後にmirror reveal）を入れて、編集が意図した進行に沿うようにします。

ライティング／マテリアルの手がかり（warm overhead lighting、chrome highlights、backlit powder cloud、steam drifting）を加えて、cinematicな質感と奥行きを向上させます。

reflection/mirrorの演出（mirror wall reflecting every action; final reveal in reflection）を含めて、連続性と強いラストのビートを確保します。

ko.content:
일관된 디자인과 스토리 전개를 고정하기 위해 Seedance prompt를 명확한 섹션(CHARACTERS, ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, TIMELINE)으로 구성하세요.

캐릭터의 외형 + 의상 + 움직임의 리듬(예: pause → burst → lock)을 정의해 퍼포먼스 스타일과 템포를 제어하세요.

샷별 카메라 언어를 타임스탬프와 함께 구체적으로 지정하세요(close-up, mirror medium shot, tracking shot, final reveal) — 이를 통해 구도와 페이싱을 안내할 수 있습니다.

핵심 소품 상호작용과 마이크로 액션(scissors spin, cape whip, razor flick, towel toss, talc brush powder cloud)을 명시해 동작의 역동성과 가독성을 높이세요.

명확한 transformation checkpoint(hair cut first, beard untouched; then beard shaved; then styling; then mirror reveal)를 추가해 편집이 의도한 진행 순서를 따르도록 하세요.

조명/재질 단서(warm overhead lighting, chrome highlights, backlit powder cloud, steam drifting)를 포함해 cinematic한 질감과 깊이를 향상시키세요.

reflection/mirror staging(mirror wall reflecting every action; final reveal in reflection)을 넣어 연속성을 강화하고 강한 엔딩 비트를 만들세요.

pt.content:
Estruture seu prompt do Seedance com seções claras (CHARACTERS, ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, TIMELINE) para garantir consistência no design e nos beats da história.

Defina a aparência do personagem + figurino + cadência de movimento (por exemplo, pause → burst → lock) para controlar o estilo de performance e o ritmo.

Especifique a linguagem de câmera shot by shot com timestamps (close-up, mirror medium shot, tracking shot, final reveal) para orientar a composição e o pacing.

Destaque interações-chave com props e microações (scissors spin, cape whip, razor flick, towel toss, talc brush powder cloud) para aumentar o nível de detalhe cinético e a legibilidade.

Use checkpoints explícitos de transformação (hair cut first, beard untouched; then beard shaved; then styling; then mirror reveal) para garantir que a edição siga a progressão pretendida.

Adicione cues de iluminação/materialidade (warm overhead lighting, chrome highlights, backlit powder cloud, steam drifting) para melhorar a textura e a profundidade cinematográfica.

Inclua staging de reflexão/espelho (mirror wall reflecting every action; final reveal in reflection) para reforçar a continuidade e um desfecho forte.

zh.content:
用清晰的部分来构建你的 Seedance prompt（CHARACTERS、ENVIRONMENT、MOOD、TIMELINE），以锁定一致的设计和故事节奏。

定义角色外观 + 服装 + 动作节奏（例如，pause → burst → lock），以控制表演风格和节奏。

使用带时间戳的分镜式镜头语言来指定拍摄方式（close-up、mirror medium shot、tracking shot、final reveal），以引导构图和节奏。

明确关键道具互动和微动作（scissors spin、cape whip、razor flick、towel toss、talc brush powder cloud），以增强动态细节和可读性。

使用明确的变形检查点（先剪头发，胡子不动；然后剃胡子；接着造型；最后镜中揭示）来确保剪辑遵循预期的推进顺序。

添加光线/材质提示（warm overhead lighting、chrome highlights、backlit powder cloud、steam drifting），以提升 cinematic 质感和层次。

加入反射/镜面调度（mirror wall reflecting every action；final reveal in reflection），以强化连贯性和有力的收尾节奏。
